podcast.title: Formation (1976)
podcast.body: Michael Hutchence, at 16, joined this band (possibly its name) in 1976 with school friends Andrew Ferris (keyboards) and Gary Beers (bass) after his family moved back to Australia. "In 1976, when he was 16 and after the family moved back to Australia, he fell in with a trio of school friends in a band that may have been called Dr. Dolphin."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Forming First Band (1976)
xref.body: At 16 in 1976, after moving back to Australia, he joined a band possibly called Dr. Dolphin with school friends Andrew Ferris (keyboards) and Gary Beers (bass), who remained his bandmates for life. His poetry was highly regarded, making him the group's lyricist. "In 1976, when he was 16 and after the family moved back to Australia, he fell in with a trio of school friends in a band that may have been called Dr. Dolphin."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
